Manulife This Cover Page is an important document. - It highlights the key features and risks of this product and should be read together with the Policy Illustration, Product Summary and Bundled Product Disclosure Document, where applicable. - It is important to read the Policy Illustration, Product Summary and Bundled Product Disclosure Document, where applicable, before deciding whether to purchase this product. If you do not have a copy of these documents, please contact us at 6737 1221 or your Financial Adviser Representative to ask for them. - You should not purchase this product if you do not understand or are not comfortable with the risks of this product. Heirloom (VII)
Product TypeUniversal Life Plan
Premium TermFlexible Premium
Policy TermWhole Life
Current Crediting Rate4.20%
Guaranteed Crediting Rate1.60%
Name of InsurerManulife (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.
Policy CurrencyUS Dollars
WHAT ARE YOU PURCHASING? This is a non-participating flexible premium universal life plan. It is a product which offers you insurance coverage and also invests part of your premiums in the insurer's Non-participating Fund. It comprises guaranteed and non-guaranteed benefits and may not be suitable for you if you want all benefits to be guaranteed. WHAT ARE THE KEY RISKS OF A UNIVERSAL LIFE PLAN? By purchasing a universal life plan, your premiums will be pooled together and invested with premiums from other policyholders in the Non-participating Fund managed by Manulife (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.. As a policyholder, the key risks commonly associated with universal life plan are:
Investment RisksLower than expected investment returns earned by the fund.
Insurance RisksHigher than expected claims made by policyholders (e.g. due to death or other terminations).
Expense RisksHigher than expected expenses incurred for managing the Non-participating Fund.
Currency RisksIf your home currency is not denominated in the Policy Currency, the payments you make or receive may be worth less over time when expressed in your home currency.
These risks can affect the crediting rate to be declared to and the charges to be deducted from the policy, which in turn affect the accumulation value. Your policy will lapse if the accumulation value is insufficient to pay for the charges. In order to keep your policy in force, you may need to pay additional premium(s). ARE THE UNIVERSAL LIFE ILLUSTRATED CREDITING RATES GUARANTEED? The Policy Illustration shows two crediting rates – current and guaranteed crediting rates. Current crediting rate is not guaranteed and may increase or decrease after the guaranteed period, subject to the guaranteed crediting rate as a minimum floor. The guaranteed crediting rate is guaranteed by the company. ARE THE UNIVERSAL LIFE ILLUSTRATED CHARGES GUARANTEED? The Policy Illustration shows two charges – current and maximum charges. Some charges may increase or decrease after the guaranteed period. Should the charges be increased from their current level, a larger deduction will be made and this will impact the accumulation value of your policy. We may adjust the charges according to factors such as the expected future claims and expenses. However, the charges will never exceed the maximum level stated in your Policy Contract. You may refer to the Product Summary for the details of the current and maximum charges for the policy. Mrs Customer Date UOB Date This illustration is only valid when all pages are included. CONFIDENTIAL Page 1 of 2 AWS / Version 94.6 / P E.&O.E. COVER PAGE FOR NON-PARTICIPATING UNIVERSAL LIFE PLAN

Coverage DescriptionInitial AmountInitial Premium

This policy is protected under the Policy Owners Protection Scheme which is administered by the Singapore Deposit Insurance Corporation (SDIC). Coverage for your policy is automatic and no further action is required from you. For more information on the types of benefits that are covered under the scheme as well as the limits of coverage, where applicable, please contact us or visit the LIA or SDIC web-sites (www.lia.org.sg or www.sdic.org.sg). The Estimated Policy Issue Date reflects the date when all initial premiums have been received, the policy is issued and the policy begins to be credited with interest. If all premiums are not received by the date selected, the policy values may differ from that which is illustrated in this Policy Illustration. For policies that are backdated, monthly charges will be effected from the requested Policy Effective Date. We will credit interest to the policy from the Policy Issue Date, regardless of policy backdating, if any. If the policy does not take effect on the date selected, the policy values may differ from that which is illustrated in this Policy Illustration. The Early Lapse Protection feature ensures that the policy will stay in force provided that the Early Lapse Protection Cumulative Premium Test is met. The Early Lapse Protection period is 5 years from the Policy Effective Date or until there is a change in life insured, whichever is earlier. During the Early Lapse Protection period, if the Net Surrender Value falls to zero or below, coverage will continue if the cumulative premiums paid since the policy was issued, net of withdrawals and any policy debt, are at least equal to the Early Lapse Protection premium, as stated in the Policy Summary, multiplied by the number of years coverage has been in effect. The Early Lapse Protection feature does not protect against a lapse in coverage, should your Policy Debt ever exceed the Policy Value. There is no additional charge for the Early Lapse Protection feature. Change in the Cost of Insurance and / or Face Amount decreases may cause the cumulative premium requirement to be recalculated, thus affecting the Early Lapse Protection feature. ## Acknowledgement: I confirm that I have received all pages of the Cover Page, Policy Illustration, Product Summary and Bundled Product Disclosure Document, where applicable for the plan. I understand that the Policy Illustration is intended for illustrative purposes only. I understand that there may be non-guaranteed elements illustrated which may be subject to change. The terms and conditions are specified in the Policy Contract. The Representative(s) has / have explained the values, key benefits and information in the Cover Page, Policy Illustration, Product Summary and Bundled Product Disclosure Document, where applicable to my satisfaction. I have also read through all the pages of the Cover Page, Policy Illustration, Product Summary and Bundled Product Disclosure Document, where applicable and understand the benefits of the plan. The above quotation is valid for two months from the date generated. Please refer to the main illustration, supplementary illustration and important notes pages for the illustration and explanation on the guaranteed scenario for this policy. Mrs Customer This illustration is only valid when all pages are included. Date UOB Page 1 of 10 Date AWS / Version 94.6 / P E.&O.E.
